newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 23.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* The summer movie season has begun with the debut of Warner Bros' "Batman & Robin" bringing in $43.6 million over the weekend.
* Walt Disney Co's "Hercules" animated musical, playing at just two theaters in Chicago and New York, generated $800,000 over the weekend.
* NBC stations in the top five markets have picked up "Roseanne," a new talk show.

* The sports cable TV joint venture of News Corp Ltd and Tele-Communications Inc is expected to announce this week that they're paying up $850 million for a 40 percent stake in the Cablevision Systems Corp sports programming services, including the Madison Square Garden network.

* Cineplex Odeon Corp has confirmed it is "in discussions" with Sony Theatres about a possible merger, but it warned that no deal had yet been reached and any deal would have to undergo regulatory scrutiny both in the U.S. and Canada.
* Great Britain is proving to be fertile foreign territory for American TV shows, as evidenced by a record price paid last week for Warner Bros' sitcom, "Veronica's Closet."
* "Sylvia," the Off Broadway comedy hit, is moving to the big screen in a production to star Steve Martin and Diane Keaton.
